originals.why: Natural fragment; gorffen keeps its 'finish' sense after ar ôl i ni.
Natural 'tan i mi orffen'; gorffen keeps its 'finish' sense.

originals.ko: 우리가 끝낸 후에 너는 뭐 할 거야?
originals.why: Idiomatic North Welsh question; gorffen keeps its 'finish' sense.

originals.ko: 나는 우리가 끝낸 후까지는 멈추고 싶지 않아
originals.why: Natural 'tan ar ôl i ni orffen'; gorffen keeps its 'finish' sense.

originals.ko: 너는 네가 가기 전에 이것을 끝내고 싶어?
나는 네가 가기 전에 이것을 끝내고 싶은데
originals.why: Natural liciwn i; the softened 싶은데 keeps it apart from dw i isio.
Natural 'that it had finished' fragment; intransitive gorffen fits.

topups.why: 'As fast as possible if I can' says the same thing twice and is unnatural.

topups.ko: 너는 가능한 한 빨리 끝낼 거야?

topups.why: Makes no sense: not wanting to speak as fast as possible because I'm tired.
'Meet as fast as possible' is unnatural; Welsh would use cyn gynted â phosib (as soon as possible).
